```python
def ref_replay(req):
    caps = req['capacities']
    flows = {f['id']: f for f in req['flows']}
    tables = {}  # (node,label) -> flow id
    enabled = set()
    results = []
    for ev in req['events']:
        op = ev['op']
        if op == 'put':
            f = flows[ev['flow']]; node = ev['node']
            i = f['path'].index(node)
            label = f['labels'][i]
            key = (node,label)
            if tables.get(key) == f['id']: st='ok'
            elif key in tables and tables[key] in enabled: st='busy'
            elif key not in tables and sum(1 for (n,l) in tables if n==node) >= caps[node]: st='full'
            else:
                tables[key]=f['id']; st='ok'
            results.append({'status':st})
        elif op=='enable':
            f=flows[ev['flow']]
            if all(tables.get((nd,f['labels'][i]))==f['id'] for i,nd in enumerate(f['path'])):
                enabled.add(f['id']); results.append({'status':'ok'})
            else: results.append({'status':'unready'})
        elif op=='disable':
            enabled.discard(ev['flow']); results.append({'status':'ok'})
        elif op=='reset':
            enabled.clear(); results.append({'status':'ok'})
        else:
            fid=ev['flow']; f=flows[fid]
            hdr=bytes.fromhex(ev['header']); pay=bytes.fromhex(ev['payload'])
            kinds=f['kinds']; tmpl=bytes.fromhex(f['template'])
            qpos=kinds.index('Q'); tpos=kinds.index('T')
            if fid not in enabled: mode,reason='ip','disabled'
            elif any(hdr[i]!=tmpl[i] for i,ch in enumerate(kinds) if ch=='K'): mode,reason='ip','mismatch'
            elif hdr[qpos]>7: mode,reason='ip','qos'
            else: mode,reason='mpls','compressed'
            N=len(f['path']); t0=hdr[tpos]
            wire=[]
            ttl=t0
            delivered=None
            # simulate hop by hop
            if ttl==0:
                pass
            else:
                for j in range(N):
                    # emit link j with current ttl
                    if mode=='mpls':
                        residue=bytes(hdr[i] for i,ch in enumerate(kinds) if ch=='D')
                        word=(f['labels'][j]<<12)|(hdr[qpos]<<9)|(1<<8)|ttl
                        wire.append(word.to_bytes(4,'big').hex()+residue.hex()+pay.hex())
                    else:
                        h2=bytearray(hdr); h2[tpos]=ttl
                        wire.append(h2.hex()+pay.hex())
                    if j==N-1:
                        # delivered
                        if mode=='mpls':
                            out=bytearray(tmpl)
                            for i,ch in enumerate(kinds):
                                if ch=='D': out[i]=hdr[i]
                                elif ch=='Z': out[i]=0
                                elif ch=='Q': out[i]=hdr[qpos]
                                elif ch=='T': out[i]=ttl
                                else: out[i]=tmpl[i]
                            delivered=out.hex()+pay.hex()
                        else:
                            h2=bytearray(hdr); h2[tpos]=ttl
                            delivered=h2.hex()+pay.hex()
                        break
                    # switch j behaviour
                    if ttl<=1: break
                    ttl-=1
            results.append({'mode':mode,'reason':reason,'wire':wire,'delivered':delivered,
                            'byte_hops':sum(len(bytes.fromhex(w)) for w in wire)})
    active=sorted(enabled)
    tabs=sorted(({'node':n,'label':l,'flow':fid} for (n,l),fid in tables.items()), key=lambda d:(d['node'],d['label']))
    return {'results':results,'active':active,'tables':tabs}
```

That's a faithful independent implementation (hop-by-hop simulation). Good for cross-checking.

Reference plan (brute force):
```python
def ref_plan(req):
    caps=req['capacities']; flows=req['flows']
    fmap={f['id']:f for f in flows}
    warmup=req['warmup']
    bens={}
    for f in flows:
        kinds=f['kinds']; tmpl=bytes.fromhex(f['template']); hdrH=len(tmpl)
        N=len(f['path']); h=N-1
        qpos=kinds.index('Q'); tpos=kinds.index('T')
        dc=kinds.count('D')
        per=(hdrH-4-dc)*N
        idx=0; tot=0
        for run in req['offers'][f['id']]:
            hb=bytes.fromhex(run['header']); cnt=run['count']
            ok = all(hb[i]==tmpl[i] for i,ch in enumerate(kinds) if ch=='K') and hb[qpos]<=7 and hb[tpos]>h
            if ok:
                lo=max(idx,warmup); hi=idx+cnt
                if hi>lo: tot += (hi-lo)*per
            idx+=cnt
        bens[f['id']]=tot
    pinned=req['pinned']
    # feasibility
    for nd,c in caps.items():
        if sum(1 for p in pinned if nd in fmap[p]['path']) > c: return {'infeasible':True}
    best=None
    ids=[f['id'] for f in flows]
    others=[i for i in ids if i not in set(pinned)]
    for mask in range(1<<len(others)):
        sel=set(pinned)|{others[j] for j in range(len(others)) if mask>>j&1}
        # capacity
        ok=True
        for nd,c in caps.items():
            if sum(1 for s in sel if nd in fmap[s]['path'])>c: ok=False;break
        if not ok: continue
        ben=sum(bens[s] for s in sel)
        key=(-ben,len(sel))
        if best is None or key<best[0]: best=(key,sel)
    sel=best[1]
    return {'selected':sorted(sel),'saved':sum(bens[s] for s in sel)}
```
Note: brute force finds min count among max benefit ✓ (any tie accepted, so compare only benefit and count, not the actual set).

For cross-checking the plan, compare `saved` and the (benefit, count) objective: since ties are accepted, compare: saved equal AND len(selected) equal AND feasibility.
